Vacation with my Stepmom
Dad promised that after a riding trip with him and my stepmom Gwen, I can go to Europe! Great! But now I need to survive eight days in the mountains with them. I hope nothing happens, because Gwen was my nanny for ten years and I have weird feelings for her.
n: [Manga] [Glyceria, Junako, Mischievous Moon] Vacation with my Stepmom [1-16] [Completed]
